mcqs.question: At the National Book Critics Circle Awards, which autobiographical book is associated with Arundhati Roy, the Booker Prize winner of 1997?
mcqs.explanation: Arundhati Roy was associated with the autobiographical book “Mother Mary Comes to Me” and won the Booker Prize in 1997. “We Do Not Part” is associated with Han Kang, while “Empire of AI” is associated with Karen Hao.
